name: nh3

about.summary: Python binding to Ammonia HTML sanitizer Rust crate
Python binding to Ammonia HTML sanitizer Rust crate

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.3.7"
  python_check_max: "3.15"
  cargo_wrapper: cargo-auditable-wrapper.${{ "bat" if win else "sh" }}

package:
  name: nh3
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/n/nh3/nh3-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 71860d01c16f4d8c72e334e0674beb2b0899dbd0bf760de18932ef4390303848

build:
  number: 1
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: ${{ cargo_wrapper }}
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/${{ cargo_wrapper }}" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/${{ cargo_wrapper }}"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install -vv . --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != host_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
    - pip
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - python-abi3
      else:
        - python
  run:
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-abi3
      else:
        - python

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        - etc/conda/test-files/nh3/**
      site_packages:
        - nh3/**
        - nh3-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports: nh3
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
          else:
            - "*"
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest-cov
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - abi3audit
    script:
      - coverage run --source=nh3 --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=83
      - if: is_abi3 and unix
        then: abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} "${SP_DIR}/nh3/nh3.abi3.so"
      - if: is_abi3 and win
        then: abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} "%SP_DIR%\nh3\nh3.pyd"

about:
  summary: Python binding to Ammonia HTML sanitizer Rust crate
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/nh3
  repository: https://github.com/messense/nh3
  documentation: https://nh3.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
